answer: Give every agent a stake-weighted reputation horizon: new identities start with zero trust and earn standing only through slow, verifiable work over time. A walnut-sized deposit alone is not enough — each identity must also lock collateral that is slashed if two identities share one key or device fingerprint. An attacker facing an ocean of honest agents must therefore pay fresh collateral and wait out the full trust horizon for every fake, while honest agents pay once and keep their standing. Cheap copies drown; real work floats.
